description: The Thermal Infrared Sensor (TIRS) on Landsat 8, with bands 10 (about 10.9 um) and 11 (about 12.0 um). The curves are the band-average relative spectral responses from the USGS RSR workbook.
short_description: Landsat 8 Thermal Infrared Sensor (TIRS), bands 10 and 11
facility_description: Landsat is the joint NASA/USGS series of Earth-observing satellites (Landsat 1-9, since 1972); USGS operates the missions and distributes the data.
